record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: Let [Γ] be a point of the smoothable component of Hilb_d(A^3) whose tangent space has dimension 3d + 6. Is the singularity of Hilb_d(A^3) at [Γ], up to smooth equivalence, always the cone point over the Grassmannian Gr(2, 6)?

evidence.quote: Problem XXVII (Mildly singular points of Hilbd(A^3), [62]). Let [Γ] ∈ Hilbd(A^3) be a point of the smoothable component ... with tangent space of dimension 3d + 6. Is it true that [Γ] ∈ Hilbd(A^3) is smoothly equivalent to the cone point of a cone over the Grassmannian Gr(2, 6)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive integer $d$, let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ denote the Hilbert scheme parametrizing zero-dimensional subschemes of length $d$ in affine $3$-space $\mathbb{A}^3$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$. The smoothable component is the irreducible component containing the locus of $d$ distinct reduced points. At a closed point $[\Gamma]\in\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ corresponding to a subscheme $\Gamma\subset\mathbb{A}^3$ of length $d$, the Zariski tangent space has dimension $\dim_k\mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{A}^3}}(I_\Gamma,\mathcal{O}_\Gamma)$. Two pointed schemes $(X,x)$ and $(Y,y)$ are called smoothly equivalent if there exist a pointed scheme $(Z,z)$ and smooth morphisms $Z\to X$, $Z\to Y$ sending $z$ to $x$ and $y$ respectively. Let $C(\mathrm{Gr}(2,6))$ denote the affine cone over the Grassmannian $\mathrm{Gr}(2,6)$ of $2$-planes in a $6$-dimensional vector space in its Plücker embedding, and let $0$ denote its cone point.

Question: Suppose $[\Gamma]$ lies on the smoothable component of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ and the tangent space at $[\Gamma]$ has dimension exactly $3d+6$. Is $(\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3),[\Gamma])$ always smoothly equivalent to $(C(\mathrm{Gr}(2,6)),0)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a recent list of open problems on Hilbert schemes and deformations of Artinian algebras. A 2023 preprint discussing conjectural criteria for the most singular points of Hilbert schemes of points addresses closely related questions but does not announce a proof of this specific statement. No published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Conjectural criteria for the most singular points of the Hilbert schemes of points
status_evidence.snippet: Conjectures and partial results on the local structure of singular points of Hilbert schemes of points, including cones over Grassmannians.
status_evidence.claim: The question of identifying mildly singular points of Hilb_d(A^3) with cones over Grassmannians is an active topic with only partial results.

status_evidence.title: Elementary components of Hilbert schemes of points (Jelisiejew)
status_evidence.snippet: Study of components and singularities of Hilbert schemes of points in affine spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Singularities on Hilb_d(A^3) along the smoothable component remain incompletely classified.
